remarks: Welcome to rural New York State, and all the scenic hills that Bolivar New York has to offer! Truly, if you are looking for a future camping site, or a secluded hunting retreat with an amazing forest feeling, then look no further than Bolivar NY in Allegany County. Presented here is an opportunity to own approximately 63 acres of green hardwood-forest land, that was once, also part of the old oil and gas industry of Allegany County. Also, included in this sale is an old power-house shed, that has a concrete base and tin siding. The shed is approximately 300 sq/ft inside with full electric service. Recently, the property was cleaned up of older campers and play equipment, and now you can create your new (R&R) rest and relaxation site.  If you are into hiking, hunting, camping, or snowmobiling, then you will enjoy the seasional nature of Bolivar and the Town of Genesee.  A cell tower does exist on this site, and this parcel has granted access easements with its own private road, which is a seasonal dirt-gravel road that leads to this parcel. A few years ago, a timber cut occurred here, and as of today, the property is filling in quite well with various beautiful hardwood trees. Several walking trails/ATV trails, and hunting stands remain on this parcel, and yes, all land rights convey to the next buyer.  Owner financing is available with a deposit, and a standard credit review.
